subject: 68 days of bass — a gift for you
preview_text: You've been with us for 68 days. I built something just for long-term users. Check your app.
body_paragraphs: 68 days ago you downloaded Bass Booster. That's 68 days of feeling the drop when others hear tinny static. I noticed — and I owe you a real thank you.
Most people quit apps after a week. You didn't. You kept boosting, kept listening. That loyalty deserves more than just a working EQ. It deserves something exclusive.

Open the app right now. I slipped in a hidden profile called 'The 68' — a custom 10-band EQ curve tuned for Hip-Hop and EDM. It's only visible to users who've been with us this long. Drag the Boost slider to 200% and hit play on any track. You'll feel the subwoofer in your chest, even on earbuds.
One tap to unlock it. That's it. No strings. P.S. — This profile is temporary. After 72 hours it disappears. Don't let the bass fade.
